subject: SFO evening shuttle + on-call sedan coverage — leadership workshop (Day 2)
body:
From: Clara Nguyen <clara@brightmeetings.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership workshop — arrival logistics + evening dinner transport

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for hosting the leadership workshop next Tuesday. A quick logistics ask for Day 2 (evening program):

- Group arriving at SFO between 14:45–15:40 (6 execs in three parties: AA 526, UA 792, private car).
- Additional staff (12) land between 15:00–16:30 and will need shuttle service to the venue (Pier 27).
- There is an offsite dinner at The Wharf Club (19:00 reservation). We need reliable return transport afterwards for guests staying at the Hilton SFO and two execs returning to downtown SF hotels.

Can Redwood coordinate: 2 on-call sedans (with driver hold for late runs), one 14-passenger shuttle with a staging window at the airport (no more than 20 min walk for guests), and 3 complimentary parking passes at Pier 27 for staging? Also please include a contingency plan if a vehicle is late (backup taxi or rideshare voucher policy).

Budget guidance: client prefers not to exceed $2k for ground ops (shuttle + sedans + staging). Let me know vendor options and a ballpark estimate; we need confirmation by EOD Wednesday to lock vendors.

Thanks — appreciate your help.

— Clara
Clara Nguyen
Event Producer, BrightMeetings
clara@brightmeetings.com
(415) 555-0142

--------------------------------------------

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara@brightmeetings.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership workshop — arrival logistics + evening dinner transport

Hi Clara — thanks, will take this on. High-level plan below; details & vendor contact info follow.

Summary plan (Day 2):
- 14:15–16:30 airport staging window: Lot B shuttle pickup (15-min max walk).
- 14-pass shuttle (BayRunner Transit) to run two trips: 15:00 and 16:20.
- 2 on-call sedans (ExecutiveCarCo) dedicated to the three exec parties; drivers will standby until 21:30 at venue.
- 3 merchant parking passes reserved at Pier 27 (staging lane B).
- Contingency: if on-call sedan delayed >10 min, we route approved rideshare (Uber Black) and charge to event card; shuttle replacement via local taxi standby (2 vehicles) if BayRunner has mechanical issues.

Estimated cost (not including tips):
- 14-pass shuttle (2 trips): $780
- 2 sedans (hold + 2 runs): $500
- Parking & staging admin fee: $120
- Contingency buffer (rideshare/taxi): $200
Estimated total: $1,600

I attached: staging map for Lot B and a driver_manifest_template so you can populate names/times. If that estimate looks good, Marissa can initiate the SOW/PO with ExecutiveCarCo and BayRunner.

Action items:
- Clara: please confirm the six exec arrival ETA list (flight numbers or car arrival times) by EOD so we can populate manifest.
- Marissa: can you confirm vendor availability & put together the SOW?

Cheers,

Maya Srinivasan
Program Manager, Events — Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com
O: 415-555-0110

Attachments: SFO_staging_map_LotB.pdf, driver_manifest_template.csv

--------------------------------------------

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Clara Nguyen <clara@brightmeetings.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership workshop — arrival logistics + evening dinner transport

Looping in vendor confirmations and procurement steps. ExecutiveCarCo and BayRunner both confirmed provisional pickup windows on 3/21 (subject to SOW).

Vendor notes:
- ExecutiveCarCo (primary sedan partner) — 2x black sedans, professional drivers, hold until 21:30. Rate card attached (ExecutiveCarCo_rate_card_2028.pdf). They accept standard Redwood PO; their standard cancellation window is 24 hours.
- BayRunner Transit — 14-pass van, ADA-accessible. Two trips as Maya suggested; driver will wait 10 min and then contact on-call dispatcher for late arrivals.

Procurement/contract steps (timeline):
1) I will prepare a one-page SOW and attach to a DocuSign (I have a draft ready).
2) Ben — can we approve up to $2k on this PO? Once approved I will send SOW to vendors and get signatures.
3) Clara — once you confirm the 6 exec ETAs, I will populate the driver manifest and provide the final pickup roster + staging pass PDF by Thursday morning.

Fallback policy (vendor-level):
- ExecutiveCarCo will dispatch a third vehicle within 30 min for any executive missed pickup; if not available, we will use Uber Black with pre-approved CC.
- BayRunner will provide a taxi fallback list; if both fail, we will schedule two smaller vans from RentalLink (backup vendor).

DocuSign SOW: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/XYZ-456-sow
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BRIGHT-8472

Marissa Cole
Event Ops Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

Attachment: ExecutiveCarCo_rate_card_2028.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Clara Nguyen <clara@brightmeetings.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership workshop — arrival logistics + evening dinner transport

Approved up to $2,000. Marissa — please proceed with SOW and collect vendor signatures. Keep receipts separate (we'll expense parking and rideshare contingencies to the event code).

Marissa, confirm once PO number is issued and ping procurement (procurement@redwood.com) to fast-track.

Thanks everyone — this plan sounds good.

Ben Carter
